success_patterns: Validate mandatory inputs for every requested domain before searching; ask only for missing details and do not make partial searches.
For follow-up constraints, retrieve the most compatible cached results, apply only the newly requested filters, and save the filtered result.
Represent a round trip as separate outbound and reverse-direction return searches, each saved independently.
